step; it does not replace those rank and torsion inputs.  The
14 September release audit did not newly execute those Magma inputs.
A separate replay on 15 September 2026 executed seven unchanged inputs
through the official Magma calculator, version V2.29-10, including both
of these full-group computations.  All seven completed successfully;
their exact input identities, output records and mathematical checks are
preserved in the separate fresh-Magma replay addendum.  This is a fresh
execution using Magma, rather than an independent implementation of its
algorithms.  The floating height comparison in that addendum does not
replace the separate exact height bounds.

changes.old:
The verified release is identified by tag
\texttt{verified-2026-09-14.1} and by the separately recorded checksum of
\path{PRIMITIVE_357_VERIFIED_RELEASE_2026-09-14_V1.zip}.
It preserves the V3, $5$-adic and rank-closure inputs under distinct
repository-relative evidence roots.  Historical archives remain immutable.
The release-level integrity and theorem-interface verifier is
\begin{center}
\texttt{python3 -B scripts/verify\_release.py}.
\end{center}
Its \texttt{--replay} mode, supplied with explicit SageMath and PARI/GP
executables and an output directory, runs the adopted reconstruction
checks.  The accompanying \path{PROGRAMS_AND_CERTIFICATES.md} gives
the exact commands, dependency indexes, successful logs and retained
imported premises.  In particular, the rank route includes the actual local
image and fake-kernel stopping proofs in Appendix~\ref{app:rank-proof},
the same-literal-$c$ comparison, and the corrected $H_0/H_1$ index
statement.  The historical V3 and post-V3 PASS records are retained as
provenance; they are not substitutes for these adopted checks.
changes.new:
The programs, exact inputs, certificates and verification records
accompanying this paper are collected in
\path{PRIMITIVE_357_FIRST_SUBMISSION_COMPANION_V1.zip}.
Its guide records the component filenames, checksums and replay
instructions.  These are versioned computational materials for this paper.

The source and data component is identified by tag
\texttt{verified-2026-09-14.1} in the repository
\href{https://github.com/bbpcho/primitive-357-proof-audit}{\texttt{bbpcho/primitive-357-proof-audit}}
and by the checksum of
\path{PRIMITIVE_357_VERIFIED_RELEASE_2026-09-14_V1.zip}.
It contains the geometric, $5$-adic and rank-closure inputs under distinct
evidence roots.  The companion also contains the argument-audit materials,
including the exact supplementary checks and seven Magma execution records.
The source and data component's integrity and theorem-interface verifier is
\begin{center}
\texttt{python3 -B scripts/verify\_release.py}.
\end{center}
Its \texttt{--replay} mode, supplied with explicit SageMath and PARI/GP
executables and an output directory, runs the specified reconstruction
checks.  The component guide \path{PROGRAMS_AND_CERTIFICATES.md} gives
the commands, dependency indexes, successful logs and retained imported
premises.  In particular, the rank route includes the actual local-image
and fake-kernel stopping proofs in Appendix~\ref{app:rank-proof},
the same-literal-$c$ comparison, and the $H_0/H_1$ index statement.
The companion guide identifies the supplementary verifiers separately;
the integrity check alone is not an arithmetic replay.
changes.reason: Describe one complete companion collection for this first paper, with existing data snapshots as versioned components.
